Wildlife

The island’s
wild side.

From elephants moving through open landscapes to sea turtles returning to the shore, Sri Lanka offers some of its most unforgettable moments far beyond its cities and beaches.

In Their World

Some encounters stay with you.

Wildlife in Sri Lanka is not always something you have to search for far away. Sometimes it appears beside the road, deep inside a national park or just beyond the shoreline. These are the encounters that remind you that you are only a visitor
in someone else’s world.
